The parser reads the wikitext most exports are made of, not all of MediaWiki. What it does not know stays as text, or loses its tag and keeps the content.

Templates and magic words: {{Infobox mountain|name=Lagazuoi|elevation=2835}}, {{cite web|url=https://example.com}}, __NOTOC__, {{#if: x | yes | no}}, {{PAGENAME}}.

References: The hut opened in 1965.<ref>Hut guide, 2020, p. 12</ref><ref name="guide" />

<references />

HTML that is not on the list: <b>bold</b>, <i>italic</i>, <span style="color:red">red</span>, <div class="note">a note</div>, <small>small</small>, <big>big</big>, <center>centered</center>, <blockquote>a quote</blockquote>, <!-- a comment -->.

Extension tags: <syntaxhighlight lang="ruby">puts "hello"</syntaxhighlight>, <math>E = mc^2</math>, <gallery>
File:One.jpg
File:Two.jpg
</gallery>

Definition lists and indentation:
; Term
: Definition
:: Indented twice
